component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.embedded
component.documentation:
Embedded panels: a record's panel shown inside another system's page, signed in with a token that the other system, a host, exchanges for its user (OAuth 2.0 token exchange, RFC 8693).
A host is registered by the server's administrators, in a file of nxserver/config/ only: a contribution from a bundle, a package's among them, is refused. Its client secret and the key its assertions are verified with are server properties or environment variables, named after its id, never in a contribution. The token is the platform's JWT, signed with nuxeo.jwt.secret, valid on the REST API only, for the host's lifetime, and held to its scope and its origins by the add-on's filter before the REST API sees the request.

extension-point.name: hosts
extension-point.documentation:
One host per element. id, the assertion's algorithm and issuer, at least one origin, and at least one user or group are required.
https://crm.example.com jsmith crm_panel_users false read Connector.Read 300
The id is 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter. The server sets the host's client secret in nuxeo.agentic.embedded.(id).clientSecret, or the environment variable NUXEO_EMBEDDED_(ID)_CLIENT_SECRET, at least 32 letters, digits, dots, underscores, tildes or dashes; and the key its assertions are verified with in nuxeo.agentic.embedded.(id).assertionKey, or NUXEO_EMBEDDED_(ID)_ASSERTION_KEY: the shared secret for HS256, at least 32 bytes, or the public key for RS256 and ES256, X.509 in base64. The id in capitals, with dashes as underscores.
An origin is https://host or https://host:port, exactly as a browser sends it, with plain http only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1]; up to 20. A user entry maps one subject of the host's to one Nuxeo user; a group lets the host name a Nuxeo user directly as its subject, a member of one of the groups only. Administrators are never signed in unless allowAdministrators is true. The scope is read, and write only if named here and asked for. An operation is one a read token may run through Automation, Connector.Read when none is named; up to 20. The token lives 60 to 900 seconds, 300 by default.
A host that fails a check is not registered, and takes one registered earlier with the same id out with it; the log says why. A later contribution with the same id replaces it whole, and enabled="false" removes it, which ends its tokens at once.
